import pandas as pd
for name in ['ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5','payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn','frontend-675fd7b5c5-68tcg']:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'metrics/pod_{name}_raw.tsv',sep='\t',dtype=str).fillna('');d['v']=pd.to_numeric(d.value,errors='coerce')

  z['ratio']=z.v_u/z.v_l
  if len(z):

  else:print('no matching points')
